title: THE LONG WAY BACK · VI · The chapel
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop six: a wedding chapel on 101 with a sign that promises no waiting, two cars in the lot, and through the window two people at an altar with their backs turned and a third figure between them the traveler can't make out. The card: two figures, a third above. He doesn't go in. He draws the lot.
